title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S02 E03 — Road Trip Rescue
Carrying three baby kangaroos and an emu, the Irwins caravan into the Australian Outback to release the animals on Mourachan, their giant wildlife conservation property; plans shift when they discover more animals in need of rescue along the way.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S02 E04 — Big Day for Baby Rhino
Terri helps prepare the zoo's new baby rhino, Carrie, to receive a lifesaving vaccine; Robert is on a rescue mission to save two black swans in very bad shape; Bindi tries to determine if a cranky wombat named Poa might be pregnant.

title: Alaskan Bush People
description:
S05 E05 — Growing the Wolfpack
An early spring provides an opportunity for the family of nine to address unfinished business; a visitor from Billy's distant past could undermine the future of Browntown.

title: Alaskan Bush People
description:
S03 E07 — High Tide Housing
The mayor of the island of Hoonah makes a surprise visit that could change the face of Browntown; the family rallies around Gabe when an opportunity comes with high risks.

title: Alaskan Bush People
description:
S05 E08 — Shots in the Dark
The wolf pack is on high alert after mysterious shots cause property damage on the shores of Browntown; the strength of the family is tested as the Browns struggle to finish a salvage job shorthanded.

title: Alaskan Bush People
description:
S05 E09 — Judgement Day
The Browns hunt and make improvements to Browntown; the family faces an unknown fate in the Alaskan city of Juneau.

title: Alaskan Bush People
description:
S05 E10 — Released to the Wild
The Brown family reunites and plans a trip after thirty long days in Juneau, but an issue plaguing one of the children puts the sanctity of the wolf pack in jeopardy.

title: Alaskan Bush People
description:
S05 E11 — Back in Browntown
The family finally returns to Browntown to reclaim the bush, but the Browns struggle with the principles that make them a Wolfpack.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E06 — Deer in the Headlights
In Ouachita Parish, a trespassing investigation leads to a dicey encounter and multiple seizures of deer; agents confront a group of duck hunters who are spotted killing non-game birds; health code violations are found during a routine oyster patrol.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E03 — Mr. Bad Guy
In southern Louisiana, Lt. David Nunez and Sgt. Austin Arteaga investigate a group of bird hunters on opening day of teal season; a repeated offender is busted for taking immature crabs; a late-night deer decoy leads to a hunter in handcuffs.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E07 — In the Eye of Hurricane Ida
As Hurricane Ida makes landfall, wildlife agents deploy to help the people of Louisiana; an injured woman is trapped in a flooded hotel; elderly neighbors await rescue in punishing conditions; lifesaving supplies must be delivered to those in need.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E05 — Blind Rage
As a storm rolls in over St. Tammany Parish, Cpl. Blaine Wagner and Cpl. Rick Clark assist in a search-and-rescue mission for a missing fisherman; agents confront a repeat offender for harassing hunters, and a felon is caught with an illegal firearm.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E02 — Fugitive on the Bayou
Wildlife agents join a manhunt for an armed fugitive on the bayou; a nervous young hunter reveals a serious violation; a night shrimping bust leads to a familiar and unrepentant culprit.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E06 — Storm Surge
The search is on for a missing boater who may have suffered a stroke on Corney Lake; wildlife agents deploy as a hurricane makes landfall, rescuing stranded survivors from the floodwaters and dispensing lifesaving supplies.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E03 — Gator Poacher
When wildlife agents find an alligator with a fresh bullet wound to the head, nearby anglers are the prime suspects; an injured hunter must be evacuated by helicopter; agents use drones to track crabbers selling their catch across state lines.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E08 — Call in the Cavalry
In the dark of the night, Officers Hannet and Masucci rush to the aid of an injured hiker trapped on Mount Monadnock; Lt. Cheney and Officer Jones patrol the Hooksett Dam, where river herring are spawning; a bear causes chaos.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E10 — Dangerous Consequences
The New Hampshire Fish and Game Dive Team fights harsh conditions while on a double drowning mission at the Merrimack River; Officer Egan rescues a baby owl after the nest is disturbed; a family of ATV riders is busted for breaking the law.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E07 — Grave Danger
The dive team searches the Ammonoosuc River for gravestones and bodies.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E11 — Squirrel Showdown
In Newton, N.H., Officer Letourneau receives an interesting tip about a woman in possession of baby flying squirrels; things take a turn for officers investigating an ATV accident; an OHRV rider is caught trespassing on restricted trails.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E09 — Raccoon Rodeo
A report of possible gunshots fired near a police chief's home has officers on the hunt for answers, but what K-9 Moxie discovers leads to a twist in the case.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E12 — Officer Down
When a reckless UTV strikes Officer Holmes from behind, Officer Mancini helps him seek medical treatment while handling the crime scene; a car accident kills a doe leaving two twin fawns vulnerable, and firecrackers give veteran intense flashbacks.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E02 — Frozen Over
Officer Hannett patrols for ice fishermen while Lt. Boudreau investigates a hunter who shot towards a road; Officer Holmes deals with a raccoon hiding in a warm chimney; Officer St. Pierre goes on his first dive recovery under the ice.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E01 — Wild Winter
Officer Bronson questions a hunter who shot a deer without having the proper permit; while Officer Demler runs radar on a popular snowmobile trail, Sgt. Lucas investigates a suspicious deer kill site; Officer Cyrs responds to a snowmobile accident.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E05 — In the Thick of It
A busy day at the state's largest ice fishing derby; Officer Canfield searches for the owner of a frozen fishing line; Major Juneau leads a mountain rescue; Officer McKee clocks the speed of snowmobiles; Officer Cyrs checks on a stuck moose.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S06 E05 — Falcon Festival
Birds of prey at the Renaissance Faire are in need of the West Nile vaccine; Piper the peppy dachshund is not so peppy; Dr. Lavigne performs surgery; Dr. Ross helps Tesla the tortoise with a fractured beak.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S06 E02 — Alpaca-lypse
Dr. Ross goes to surgery when constipation becomes serious for a tegu lizard; Dr. Blue treats a boxer that can barely breathe; the doctors help a baby alpaca in distress and are given VIP access to a special event as a thank-you.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S06 E06 — Hermaphrodite Hound
Dr. Lavigne does a not-so-routine surgery on a hermaphrodite dog that's both male and female; a bearded dragon battles a skin disease that Dr. Ross must treat before it causes serious problems; Dr. Blue manages work and a big family move.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S06 E08 — Daddy Day Care
The docs are on double duty when Dr Ross brings his daughter into the clinic; a dog is rushed to Dr Lavigne after suffering multiple seizures and Dr Blue performs a tricky surgery; the staff must tame a feisty feline patient.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S02 E03 — On the War Path
A vicious cat named Kleo terrorizes her home, keeping the owners from their wedding day; another couple is desperate for Jackson's help with their cat Marco who tortures their tiny dog Yuki.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S02 E05 — Cat Fight!
Jackson must figure out what is triggering his next feline's aggressive behavior. A crazed cat is enraged by her owners' roommate; a newlywed couple is concerned after their two cats behavior suddenly becomes unruly.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S02 E06 — Spitting Mad
Polly displays anger by vomiting and attacks as soon as she gets the opportunity; Black Rose and Mathilda battle for control over their keeper's home.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E12 — Swamp Don't Care
All-star survivalists Jake Nodar and Melissa Miller take on a punishing Florida swamp teeming with poisonous snakes and aggressive alligators; when one of the survivalists becomes disoriented, authorities are called in to conduct an all-out search.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E02 — Frozen and Afraid
Dropped onto a frozen Alaskan glacier, all-star survivalists Laura Zerra and Steven Hall scramble to stave off frostbite and hypothermia; 7,000 miles south, two new survivalists take on a sun-scorched Brazil island, with anaconda and deadly stingray.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E08 — Bite Club
A survivor of rattlesnake, shark and bear attacks teams up with Matt Wright's wife, Brooke; together, they take on lions and hyenas in a vicious African feeding ground where the environment quickly puts their skills to the test.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E18 — Honduran Hell
In the mountainous rainforest of Honduras, a survivalist with an unusual past is paired with a hard-headed police detective to try and survive 21 days, but predatory jaguars, swarms of fire ants and a debilitating injury threaten their challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E05 — Threesome
When a third survivalist crashes the challenge, tension and jealousy are just as threatening as the piranha and jaguars of the Ecuadorian rainforest; claims that there's more going on than just survival puts everyone's challenge at risk.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E07 — Stomping Grounds
Elite survivalists Matt Wright and Gary Golding are tested by deadly spitting cobras and territorial elephants in an African killing zone; however, Matt and Gary aren't alone, and they must protect novices from the threats surrounding them.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S09 E07 — Love at First Fight
Instant attraction gives way to unforgiving conditions on a Nicaraguan island teeming with bull sharks and big cats; as the struggle to survive hits a low point, a flood threatens to wipe out the camp and all chances of survival.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S03 E03 — Killers on the Loose
A pet python kills a family's young daughter; Chuck searches the Everglades for an aggressive Burmese python; a red tail boa is loose in a suburban neighborhood.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S03 E05 — Deadly Reptile Mix
Lt. Lisa Wood nearly loses a leg to an alligator blocking a roadway; the Venom One team encounters three deadly snakes.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S03 E02 — Snake-Bitten Kids
A child is sent into a coma after being bitten by a poisonous coral snake; Lt. Cullen learns that his niece has been bitten by a water moccasin.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E05 — The Javan Tiger
Forrest Galante visits the island of Java in Indonesia to look for the Javan Tiger; this exotic predator was declared extinct in 2003, but park rangers and locals have had recent sightings and are collecting evidence of its existence.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E02 — The Madagascar Giant
Madagascar's Pachylemurs were red, furry giants, nearly the size of great apes; recently discovered remains disprove that they went extinct 1,000 years ago; Forrest tries to prove the giant species still lives.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E06 — The Tasmanian Tiger Down Under
After numerous credible eyewitness accounts of the Tasmanian Tiger in Australia, James Cook University has researchers on the move; Forrest joins their study before heading deep into the Cape York Peninsula.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E08 — The Dodo of the North
Forrest travels to the Faroe Islands to look for any trace of the great auk; his passionate search for a large flightless seabird takes him through some of the most scenic and rugged terrain he's ever seen.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E11 — Low Rider
Tumor lowers the chances of a dog finding a forever home; violent dog puts the VRC staff in danger; search is on for stray dog's owner.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E10 — A New Best Friend
Tia and her crew race to rescue an abandoned pit bull stranded in an empty house; at Villalobos, Tia's dog Jethro falls dangerously ill while a mother and daughter arrive seeking a new best friend.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E17 — The Incomparable Dr. K
Disease outbreak in the swamps threatens the safety of the dogs; Tania goes out on a difficult rescue; Jackson gets a shot at a forever home.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E18 — New Day, New Blood
Tia finds herself short-handed as Villalobos begins to expand; pack of running pit bulls leads to an overwhelmed owner; Tia and Lizzie try to find Gidget a forever home for her final days.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E15 — Behind Bars
Tia adopts a patrol dog out to Matt's former home, Dixon prison; owners of two dogs abandon property and dogs; putting Brandi up for adoption upsets Tania.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E13 — A Long Time Coming
In one of the worst cases of neglect Tia has ever seen, the team tries to nurse a severely malnourished dog back to health; ten years after Hurricane Katrina, one of the survivors finally has a chance at a forever home; celebrating 100 episodes.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E09 — The One
The team rallies to get a scared dog out from under a vehicle; Tania's in-laws desire a new dog; Tia's son Moe and his fiancée Lizzy prepare for their big day.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E14 — Eye of the Storm
